text:
Cara Li: seeing a spike of 413s on embeddings when clients send mixed 1536/768 batches. telemetry shows packets getting dropped in the splitter path. anyone else?
Ben Park: yup, noticed yesterday. mostly from mobile clients batching variable-dim inputs into one request.
Alice Gómez: is this the same 413 fingerprint as the chunker limit (payload-bytes) or is it a dims-mismatch failure?
Cara Li: payload-bytes + sanity check in splitter currently assumes uniform dims. if mixed, we try to autosplit but sometimes the preflight metric doesn't run and the request hits nginx limit first.
Dylan R.: so two failure modes: (1) preflight not executed -> big payload -> 413, (2) preflight runs but split plan invalid -> runtime 400?
Erin S.: can we add an early validation that returns a structured error with dims hint instead of 413? clients could fast-fail and re-chunk.
Ben Park: agree. +1 to a well-typed error: `{"error":"embed_mixed_dims","hint":"send as multiple requests or use dims header"}`. we should include `X-Embed-Dims` header suggestion.
Cara Li: sample preflight header we discussed earlier: `X-Embed-Dims: 1536,768` and we could return `split_plan` in preflight response e.g. `{"plan":[2,1]}` for three items
Alice Gómez: careful: leaking split_plan might couple clients to internal routing. maybe return abstract advice `{"suggested_split":"size_based","max_bytes":1048576}`
Dylan R.: internal debate: server-side auto-splitting cost vs client responsibility. Auto-split increases throughput but doubles payload handling and latency in worst-case.
Erin S.: for UX, I'd prefer server auto-split as beta with a console toggle per-route. platform teams can enable it for PLG customers and disable for enterprise strict quotas.
Ben Park: console toggle needs telemetry: per-route error counts, preflight success ratio, avg split latency. we don't currently surface preflight metrics in the dashboard.
Cara Li: adding those metrics to the console sounds necessary. proposal: `embed.preflight.requests`, `embed.preflight.failures`, `embed.auto_split.rate`, `embed.split_avg_latency_ms`.
DevBot: deploy pipeline: preflight-metrics PR landed on staging (sha abc123). running canary on embed-route-2.
Alice Gómez: also we need quota semantics clarified: when auto-split is server side, does each split consume quota separately? legal/team asked about billing clarity.
Dylan R.: ops prefers each final decode token count to bill. so a single client request that auto-splits should count as sum of tokens produced across splits. need doc change.
Erin S.: UX for rollouts: default off, canary 10% traffic, alert if `embed.preflight.failures > 1%` or `413_rate > 0.5%`.
Ben Park: implementation note: move dim-check earlier in the filter chain so nginx sees smaller bytes. quick patch: `filters/embed_preflight.lua` runs before `client_body_buffer_size` check.
Cara Li: test plan: fuzz mixed dims with sizes (1..64) and random text sizes, verify we never surface raw 413 to caller, only structured `embed_mixed_dims` or successful split.
Alice Gómez: console should link to example client-side re-chunking snippet for SDKs. small code block idea: 
```
# python
from redwood import Embeddings
emb = Embeddings()
# if you get embed_mixed_dims -> split on dims and retry
```
Dylan R.: also add debug tag in logs `embed.split_trace` with split decisions for support. keep it off by default due to PII concerns.
Erin S.: security: ensure preflight response doesn't echo full payload. only dims and size hints.
Ben Park: plan LGTM. next steps: (1) server preflight early filter patch, (2) console metrics + toggle, (3) SDK doc + client fast-fail guidance, (4) billing doc update.
Cara Li: I'll own (1) and (4). Ben, Alice can you take (2)/(3)?
Alice Gómez: I'll pick up console metrics + dashboard UI copy.
Ben Park: I'll do the SDK examples and coordinate with docs.
DevBot: rolling canary: embed-route-2 -> 10% traffic at 3032101250, health ok.
Cara Li: thanks everyone. will open tasks + assign. :thumbsup:
